rules.why: Emerson 2026-10-03: rather basic, exactly specified tasks go to Sonnet 5.5 at medium to save usage

ladder: If a result is not good enough: Sonnet medium -> Sonnet high -> Opus high -> Fable 5.1 at high (2.5x Opus; only when Opus high still falls short).
